name: Calm Emotions
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Once per rest: Choose a point within medium range. Roll Spirit vs Spirit against each creature within short range of that point. A creature may choose to lose the check.

On each win, the creature's emotions are calmed: it unchecks one Condition and any effects causing it to be charmed are temporarily suppressed.

Describe how you induce calm.
successes:
✨: On each win, the creature unchecks 2 Conditions.

🌞: On each win, any effects causing the creature to be charmed immediately end.
